protocol: Alternating arm order inside every independent pair, one fresh benchmark process per arm, one discarded warm-up sample per process, all measured samples retained. Median seconds per arm; speedup is the main-baseline median divided by the arm median. Small workloads use 4 self-play games (8 plies, 32 visits) and 8 Shieldbearer evaluation games (16 plies, 32 visits); large workloads use 12 games with 16 plies and 48 visits. --workers 0 is the in-process scheduler on this branch, so it is the control for the shared-scheduler refactor; the main arm is the extracted baseline.
